encyclopedia.title: Cunningham's Encyclopedia of Magical Herbs
encyclopedia.description: Comprehensive guide to the magical uses and correspondences of 400+ herbs and plants
encyclopedia.author: Scott Cunningham
encyclopedia.introduction: The power behind herb magic is formless and eternal. Herbs contain energies and vibrations that match specific magical needs. By understanding the powers resident in herbs, you can manipulate them to cause needed changes.

herbs.name: Acacia
herbs.description: A thorny tree producing fragrant flowers and gum resin. Used in incense and ceremonial magic.
magicalApplications: Burn as incense for spiritual connection
Use in sachets for protection during travel
Add to bath water for purification rituals
Carry as talisman for psychic development

preparation.storage: Keep in sealed container, away from moisture

herbs.name: Basil
herbs.description: Aromatic herb with green leaves and small flowers. Sacred in Hindu tradition and European witchcraft.
magicalApplications: Place in bedroom to attract love
Sprinkle around home for protection
Add to food for harmony in relationships
Burn for spiritual cleansing
Wear as charm for prosperity

preparation.storage: Hang dry in dark place or freeze fresh

herbs.name: Chamomile

magicalApplications: Brew as tea for emotional calming
Use in pillow sachets for restful sleep

Burn at dawn for new beginnings
Place on altar for gentle magic

preparation.form: Dried Flowers, Tea, Essential Oil, Bath Soak

herbs.name: Cinnamon

Wear for spiritual power and confidence
